name: Portuguese Bacalhau à Brás
description: Bacalhau à brás, one of Portugal's most iconic dishes, genuinely depends on real technique at the very end - the pan comes off the heat before the eggs look fully set, since real bacalhau à brás should be soft and creamy throughout, never a dry scramble; real salted cod is traditionally soaked 24-48 hours to desalt, and fresh fish stands in here as a milder, more accessible substitute.

ingredients_full.note: poached and flaked, standing in for real salted cod
tbsp, chopped, standing in for parsley

ingredients.note: poached and flaked, standing in for real salted cod
tbsp, chopped, standing in for parsley

steps_detailed: Fry the matchstick potatoes in the oil until golden and crisp, 5-6 minutes, then set aside.
Cook the onion and garlic in a little oil, 4-5 minutes.
Add the flaked fish and fried potatoes, and toss together over medium heat, 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently, taking the pan off the heat while the eggs still look slightly underdone - real technique keeps this soft and creamy, not a dry scramble.
Top with the olives and parsley before serving.

name: Portuguese Caldo Verde
description: Caldo verde, a real potato and kale soup, is one of Portugal's most beloved everyday dishes, real technique blending the potato base completely smooth before adding the real thinly shredded kale, which cooks in just minutes.
steps_detailed: Simmer the potato, onion, and garlic in 2.5 cups water 18-20 minutes until completely tender.
Blend until completely smooth.
Return to the pot, add the thinly shredded kale, and simmer just 4-5 minutes until tender.
Cook the sausage separately, 8-9 minutes, and add to the soup with a drizzle of olive oil before serving.

name: Portuguese Francesinha
description: Francesinha, a real Porto sandwich layered with meat and covered in melted cheese and a beer-tomato sauce, real technique broils the top so the cheese melts into a real molten blanket over the whole sandwich.

ingredients_full.ingredient: 365 (Whole Foods) 365 Everyday Value, White Hamburger Buns

steps_detailed: Cook the sausage and bacon together, 6-7 minutes.
Simmer the tomatoes and beer together 10-12 minutes into a sauce.
Assemble the sandwich with the meat, top with the cheese, and pour the sauce over.
Broil 3-4 minutes until the cheese melts into a real molten blanket over the whole sandwich.

name: Portuguese Piri Piri Chicken
description: Frango piri-piri, chicken basted in a real fiery chili sauce, is one of Portugal's most beloved exports, real technique basting continuously through grilling, not just at the start.
steps_detailed: Blend the jalapeño, garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil into a smooth sauce.
Marinate the chicken in the sauce at least 30 minutes.
Grill, turning and basting with more sauce every few minutes, 12-15 minutes, until charred and cooked through.

name: Portuguese Pastel de Nata
description: Pastel de nata, real custard tarts with a caramelized top, real technique baking at a genuinely very high heat so the custard develops real dark caramelized spots while the pastry stays crisp.
steps_detailed: Layer the phyllo sheets, brushing each with melted butter, then roll into a log and slice into rounds; press each into a muffin tin.
Whisk the cream, egg yolks, and sugar together.
Fill each pastry cup with the custard.
Bake at 450F (230C) for 15-18 minutes, until the custard develops real dark caramelized spots on top.

name: Portuguese Grilled Fish
description: Grilled fish rubbed with garlic and olive oil, reflecting Portugal's extensive Atlantic coastal fishing tradition.
steps_detailed: Rub the fish with the garlic and olive oil, and let sit 10 minutes.
Grill or broil, 4-5 minutes per side, until just cooked through.

name: Portuguese Roasted Almonds
description: A simple roasted almond snack, common across Portugal.
steps_detailed: Toast the almonds in a dry pan over medium heat, stirring often, 4-5 minutes, until fragrant.

description: A simple, hearty beef and vegetable stew, common Portuguese home cooking outside the specific named dishes.

Add the carrot, potato, and tomatoes, and simmer 30-35 minutes until tender.
